title: Fanar: An Arabic-Centric Multimodal Generative AI Platform
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the model's ability to accurately handle religious prompts and controversial Islamic issues using a customized Islamic Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system. It also measured the model's alignment with Islamic cultural and religious values in both text generation and image modality (e.g., ensuring culturally appropriate image generation and preventing depictions of Muslims drinking alcohol).
findings: The models successfully utilized a specialized Islamic RAG system connected to a vector database of curated Islamic literature to accurately answer religious prompts. By applying expert-driven synthetic data generation and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), the models were heavily aligned with Islamic cultural values, proving capable of navigating controversial Islamic topics appropriately. In multimodal tests, the developers successfully trained the model to override base model biases, preferring to generate culturally appropriate images rather than offensive ones (such as depicting Muslims drinking alcohol). Overall, the Fanar models achieved top-tier performance on cultural benchmarks compared to similarly sized models.
